function: Learned joint design of BS information/energy beamforming vectors, STAR-RIS transmission and reflection coefficients, and common-rate allocation to maximize weighted sum rate and harvested energy (p. 6)
system: N=4-antenna BS, K=4 single-antenna users (IDRs and EHRs), STAR-RIS with M=20 elements (simultaneously transmitting and reflecting); frequency band not stated (p. 7)
method: Meta-DDPG: actor-critic deep reinforcement learning with a meta-learning bi-level update of the actor (inner and outer loops); reinforcement and meta-learning paradigms (pp. 5-6)
data_channel: No channel model, path-loss law, or dataset named; only quasi-static block flat-fading with CSI available, and CSI forms the RL state (pp. 4, 6, 7)
test_conditions: Training and test conditions not separated; results sweep maximum transmit power (8-20 dBm) and weight alpha, plus reward convergence over episodes; no unseen scenario is evaluated (pp. 7-8)
baselines: Non-learned: alternating optimization (AO), exhaustive-search optimum; learned: PPO, standard DDPG; Meta-DDPG on conventional (non-STAR) RIS as system baseline (pp. 7-8)
metrics: Normalized weighted objective (sum rate plus harvested energy), average data rate (bps/Hz), average normalized harvested energy, reward convergence over episodes (pp. 7-8)
complexity: Big-O only: training O(T*E*Nt*Sb*S), online O(T*E*Sb*S), S = sum over layers of delta_i*delta_(i+1) (neurons per layer); no runtime or FLOPs (p. 8, Table 2)
openness: none (no code or data link and no availability statement)
q1_support: p. 4: "quasi-static block flat-fading" - no standardized, ray-traced or measured channel is named; the p. 7 setup lists only M, K, N, node positions and Pmax, so the channel source is not described.
q2_support: p. 7: "varied across a range of values, spanning" - only a transmit-power sweep (8 dBm to Pmax); p. 6: "allows for faster adaptation when the environment changes" is a claim, but no result on an unseen scenario is reported.
q3_support: p. 7: "PPO algorithm in terms of performance" (Meta-DDPG outperforms the learned PPO baseline) and "mathematical AO method" (non-learned AO, plus exhaustive-search optimum), all plotted in Fig. 3 on the objective.
q4_support: p. 8: "algorithm is systematically assessed using Big-O" - Table 2 gives the training-mode and online-mode Big-O orders.
q5_support: p. 7: "M = 20 and K = 4" - simulation parameters only; the paper gives no code or data link, no public dataset, and no availability statement.
notes: Included, area 3: Meta-DDPG learns BS information/energy beams, STAR-RIS coefficients and the common-rate split (p. 6). Tables 1 and 2 were read from page images (pp. 3, 8). The DDPG curves are the ablation of Meta-DDPG without meta-learning, so q3 rests on PPO (p. 2 cites [16], a PPO method for STAR-RIS with RSMA) and on AO. Channel generation is never described.
